categories.main_business_segments: Shandong Longhua New Material Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, production, and sales of polyether polyols and polyamide resins. Its product portfolio includes polymer polyols (POP), CASE polyether, terminal amino polyether, and general soft foam polyether, as well as nylon 66, long-chain nylon (bio-based), transparent nylon, and high-temperature nylon. The company serves industries such as furniture, footwear, automotive interiors, waterproof materials, adhesives, wind power blades, and epoxy flooring.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced continuous production methods for polyether polyols, including proprietary technologies for high solid content (up to 50%), low viscosity, non-gelling upon water contact, ultra-low VOC emissions, and high whiteness. It has developed innovative POP products with independent intellectual property rights and employs energy-saving and environmentally friendly production processes. For polyamide resins, the company focuses on engineering plastics with superior mechanical and thermal properties, leveraging domestic raw material technologies and advanced polymerization techniques.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include well-known mattress brands (e.g., Mlily, SLEEMON, KUKA), footwear brands (e.g., Li Ning, Anta, Nike, Adidas), automotive interior suppliers for brands like Yutong Bus, Mercedes-Benz, and Beiqi Foton, waterproof building material companies, adhesive manufacturers, wind power blade producers, and epoxy flooring companies. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with significant sales in Southeast Asia, South Asia, and Eastern Europe.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with its headquarters and main production facilities located in Zibo City, Shandong Province. It has expanded its market presence internationally, particularly in Southeast Asia, South Asia, and Eastern Europe. The company also has a wholly-owned subsidiary in Shanghai focused on new material production.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shandong Longhua New Material operates mainly in the midstream segment of the chemical materials supply chain, producing key intermediate materials such as polyether polyols and polyamide resins used by downstream manufacturers in furniture, footwear, automotive, and other industries. It procures raw materials like propylene oxide, styrene, acrylonitrile, and ethylene oxide from multiple upstream suppliers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation and product development, focusing on improving production efficiency, product quality, and environmental performance. R&D efforts include developing high-performance polyether polyols with low VOC, amino polyether polyols for specialized applications, environmentally friendly hard foam polyols, and advanced polyamide resins such as bio-based long-chain nylon and transparent nylon. It invests significantly in expanding production capacity and upgrading automation and energy-saving technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of chemical products, specifically polyether polyols and polyamide resins. The company employs a 'prepayment before delivery' sales model, with direct sales to end manufacturers and distributors. It also earns investment income from financial assets and government subsidies related to its operations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic manufacturer in the polyether polyol industry, ranking among the top in China by production capacity. It competes with other major chemical material producers in the polyether and polyamide resin sectors, focusing on high-value-added products with proprietary technologies to differentiate itself. Its strong R&D capabilities and broad customer base in multiple downstream industries provide competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 5.62 billion, a 12.01% increase from the previous year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 171.38 million, down 30.90% year-over-year, mainly due to decreased gross margins. Total assets reached RMB 3.23 billion, up 22.19%. The company is actively expanding production capacity, with ongoing projects to increase polyether polyol capacity by 33,000 tons per year and polyamide resin capacity by 8,000 tons per year.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shandong Longhua New Material emphasizes high-quality, differentiated products with superior technical performance such as high solid content, low viscosity, ultra-low VOC emissions, and environmental friendliness. Its proprietary POP technology and continuous production processes enhance product stability and efficiency. The company offers customized solutions tailored to diverse customer needs across multiple industries, supported by strong R&D and innovation capabilities, enabling it to maintain a leading market position and build long-term partnerships with prominent brands.
